title: Test flake: DataPillar.panelHold-27629 'leaving the Actions tab keeps the hold' sometimes sees a save of the unparsable predicate (fails 1 in ~5–8 runs on main)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRB34k9WUWeGpRnVNm

Suggested-grade: p2
Suggested-domain: `domain:ui`

## What happens

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/DataPillar.panelHold-27629.test.tsx`, describe "DataPillar — an action predicate that does not parse holds with the draft (objectstack#27629)", case "leaving the Actions tab keeps the hold, and the held line names the action", fails intermittently at line 233:

```
AssertionError: expected "vi.fn()" to not be called at all, but actually been called 1 times
```

The save mock received the object draft with the action `visible: "record.status =="` (the unparsable predicate the case types), after `leaveToForm()` + `outlastDebounce()`. So either the hold does not survive leaving the tab under load (a product race), or the test's debounce wait is shorter than the real debounce under a loaded box (a test race). Not diagnosed here.

## Readings

- Merge queue, PR #36603 (a record top-bar change that touches no Studio file): queue run 45105220119, job `Test UI (16/16)` 137465526451 failed on this case alone (389 of 390 files passed). Base `ed0edb1b50` (#36597's merge, "the object page saves with Cancel and Save in the top bar, live at once"); #36597's own queue run was green.
- Area s2-B's container, `vitest run --maxWorkers=2` on this file alone, under the verify lock:
  - origin/main `ed0edb1b50`: 4 of 4 green, then 7 of 8 green (1 failed, same case and same assertion).
  - origin/main merged with PR #36603: 4 of 5 green (1 failed, same case).
- So the failure reproduces on main without the PR (readings taken 2026-11-23 between 03:40 and 03:55 UTC on a shared box).

## Done when

The case passes 20 of 20 runs in a row on a loaded box, with the root cause named (hold race or test timing). If the product drops the hold under load, that is the fix, not a longer wait.

Dedupe: open-issue search `DataPillar panelHold` → only #27629 (closed, the feature card). No flake card.
